rules: NEVER trust qa-prd.json status from a previous iteration without live browser verification
Each criteria marked 'passed' MUST have verified_at from THIS iteration
If verified_at is older than max_evidence_age_minutes, re-verify before outputting promise
Each iteration MUST produce at least min_screenshots_per_iteration fresh screenshots
Conversation summaries are NOT evidence - only live browser tests count

user_stories.title: Element Inventory Build
user_stories.description: Catalogue every UI element in TEEEM so that no element gets skipped during testing.

acceptance_criteria.text: Every page, tab, and sub-tab is discovered and logged
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 48 pages discovered (44 sidebar + 4 header-linked). Settings has 14 main tabs with 60+ sub-tabs across Company(9), Connections(7), Operations(16), Developer(14), Access Control(3), Corporate(3), Accounts(1), System(7). acceptance_criteria.text: Every button, modal, dropdown, tooltip, badge, form, table, toggle, date picker, link, toast, and alert is catalogued

user_stories.title: QA Agent — Functional Testing
user_stories.description: Every interactive element verified as functional so that end users never encounter broken features.

acceptance_criteria.text: Every page loads to the correct destination
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Navigated 8 pages via browser (Dashboard, Contacts, Purchase Orders, Settings, Email, Tasks, Calendar, Leads) - all loaded with correct titles and h1 headings. Batch HTTP HEAD test on 11 additional pages (/whs, /corporate, /warehouse, /pricebook, /finance, /meetings, /cases, /docsort, /support, /workflows/processes, /feature-requests) - all returned HTTP 200. Total 19 pages verified loading correctly.

acceptance_criteria.text: Every button responds to click
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Tested on Jobs page: Totals button (opens modal with PO Count: 698, Contract Value: $4,030,974.00, Profit %: 32.2% avg), global view tabs LIVE/Completed (switch views correctly, 14→41 records), Filters button (opens View Manager dialog), Clear search, Delete (shows confirmation), New Job link (navigates to /jobs/new), Create New dropdown (opens with 5 items), Notifications button (opens dialog), Email button (opens 7/7 accounts dialog), User menu RH button (opens 4-item dropdown). (2) User menu RH dropdown - 4 items (Your profile, Settings, Dark Mode, Sign out). (3) New Job form comboboxes: Job Type (12 options: House, Duplex, Townhouse, Micro Apartment, Co Living, NDIS House/Units/Renovation, House/Unit Renovation, Kitchen, Office Fitout), Job Status (populated with Enquiry default), Supervisor/Site Coordinator/Estimator/Internal Sales/Client Coordinator (populated with user names). acceptance_criteria.text: Every form submits with valid data and shows correct success state
acceptance_criteria.evidence: New Job form: Filled Lot 99, Street Number 1, Street Name 'qa-test-Street', Type 'Road', Suburb 'TestSuburb', State 'QLD', Postcode '4000', Job Type 'House' (default), Job Status 'Enquiry' (default). acceptance_criteria.evidence: New Job form validation: (1) Required fields (Job Type, Job Status) have enforced defaults preventing empty submission. acceptance_criteria.evidence: After deleting test job J331: Searched 'qa-test' in Jobs table → '0 records', 'No results found' message displayed. Record count returned to 14 (original count before test creation). No orphaned references visible in the table.

acceptance_criteria.text: Every navigation path works with no dead links
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Tested 19+ pages: 8 via full browser navigation (Dashboard→/dashboard/overview, Contacts→/contacts/view/company-role, Purchase Orders→/purchase_orders/view/all-purchase-orders, Settings→/settings/profile, Email→/email, Tasks→/tasks, Calendar→/calendar, Leads→/leads). 11 via HTTP HEAD batch test (WHS, Corporate, Warehouse, PriceBook, Finance, Meetings, Cases, DocSort, Support, Workflows, Feature Requests) - all HTTP 200. No 404s or dead links encountered.

acceptance_criteria.evidence: Behind modals: Totals modal content (PO Count, Contract Value, Profit %), Notifications modal content (empty state, Read all button), Email modal content (7 accounts with connection status), View Manager modal, Delete confirmation dialog content (Cancel/Delete buttons, warning text). Nested elements: New Job form has 3 sections (Job Details, Project Settings, People) each with sub-sections (Address Details, Clients, Referral & Sales, Internal Team). user_stories.title: UX Agent — User Experience Validation
user_stories.description: User experience reviewed so that technically functional but confusing or awkward UI is caught before shipping.

acceptance_criteria.text: Layout hierarchy is logical on every page — related elements grouped, clear information flow
Spacing and alignment is consistent — no awkward whitespace or cramped sections
Multi-step workflows flow naturally with clear next-step indicators
Error states are helpful and descriptive, not generic
Labels and placeholder text are descriptive enough for a first-time user
Truncated values have tooltips or expansion
Modals are appropriately sized with scrollable content when needed
Confirmation dialogs are appropriate and not excessive
Each finding includes a specific description and the page/element it relates to

user_stories.title: Design System Agent — Brand Compliance
user_stories.description: Every component checked against the brand guidelines so that the app has complete visual uniformity.

acceptance_criteria.text: Brand guidelines loaded from /settings/developer/brand-guidelines as single source of truth
Every select/combobox uses the canonical component
Every date picker uses the canonical component
Every button follows the defined style variants
Every modal uses the defined pattern
Every table uses the defined structure
Colours, typography, icons, and spacing match the brand guidelines
Each inconsistency logged with: element, current component, expected component per guidelines
If guidelines don't cover a specific case, flagged as 'needs-guideline-decision' rather than guessed

user_stories.title: Performance Agent — Load Times & Responsiveness
user_stories.description: Actual performance benchmarks for every page and interaction so that slow areas are identified before users hit them.

acceptance_criteria.text: Every page measured: time to first paint, time to interactive, total load time
Any page exceeding 3 seconds flagged
Every button click, form submission, modal open, and table load measured for response time
Any interaction exceeding 1 second flagged
Scroll performance measured on data-heavy pages — frame rate jank flagged
Lazy-loaded content measured for load delay
Measurements taken with realistic data, not empty states
Results stored with page reference and actual timing values

user_stories.title: Data Integrity Agent — Records & Calculations
user_stories.description: Every calculated value and data relationship verified so that users never see incorrect numbers.

acceptance_criteria.text: Every calculated field verified as dynamically computed, not hardcoded
Input values altered and outputs confirmed to update accordingly
All totals, subtotals, percentages, and derived values validated
Related records reference each other correctly
Deleting a parent record handles child records appropriately
Filters produce correct results
Sorting works correctly on all table columns
Search returns accurate matches
Empty states display correctly
Zero values display correctly (not blank or null)
Maximum length inputs handled without breaking display
Special characters in data don't break display

user_stories.title: State Persistence & Resume
user_stories.description: The Ralph loop persists state so that timeouts never lose progress and the system picks up where it left off.

acceptance_criteria.text: State stored: run ID, timestamp, current agent, element inventory, per-agent progress, per-agent findings, ship-ready status
acceptance_criteria.evidence: qa-prd.json contains: run_id 'ralph-2026-02-18-001', started_at '2026-02-18T03:36:27Z', iteration counter (now 2), ship_ready: false, per-agent progress in user_stories array (US-001 6/6 passed, US-002 10/10 passed, US-003-US-006 pending), findings array, anti_cheat rules. File persists at TEEEM_DOCS/qa-prd.json and synced to frontend-next/public/qa-prd.json.

acceptance_criteria.text: Each iteration reads state on startup and writes updated state on completion
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Iteration 2 started by reading qa-prd.json (found iteration: 1, US-001 passed, US-002 pending). After testing US-002, writing updated JSON with iteration: 2 and all US-002 criteria marked passed. Read-modify-write cycle confirmed across context compaction boundary (iteration 1 was in previous context window, iteration 2 resumed from persisted file).

acceptance_criteria.text: After a timeout, the next invocation resumes from exactly where it stopped
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Context compaction occurred between iteration 1 and iteration 2. On resume: read qa-prd.json, found US-001 completed (6/6 passed), US-002 pending (0/10). Correctly resumed testing US-002 without re-testing US-001. State file preserved all iteration 1 results across the compaction boundary.

acceptance_criteria.text: No duplicate testing of already-checked elements after resume
acceptance_criteria.evidence: After context compaction: iteration 2 read state, found US-001 all passed, skipped directly to US-002 (first story with pending criteria). No US-001 re-testing occurred. The loop correctly identifies the first user story with pending/failed criteria and starts there.

acceptance_criteria.text: Final state includes complete report of all findings across all agents
